title: reversal vs microstep resolution, and speed
_note: Procedure F0b_pt2_procedure.md. Every position is in 1/256 counts, the one internal unit; a target is legal at a given MRES only if it is divisible by 2^mres_code counts. The builder asserts that for every segment at the MRES in force.
_window_note: Both are offsets from t_last_edge, not durations from when the segment was issued: DWELL ends at t_last_edge + settle_ms, MARK at t_last_edge + settle_ms + record_ms. The analysis reads 0.3-0.5 s inside the settle and 2.0-2.5 s as the mark.
_m_speed_note: E5 settings. 2 mm/s at 1/256 is 51200 Hz; the pre-run bench check must confirm the RMT path produces it cleanly. Fallback: set m_speed_mm_s to 1.0 and v_extra_coarse to true, which adds a 1/16 at 2 mm/s visit to block V.
_v_extra_note: Set true only with the m_speed_mm_s = 1.0 fallback: adds a 1/16 at 2 mm/s visit so the E5 condition is still covered somewhere in the session.
